The '''concussion rifle''' was an uncommon [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] that fired a concussive energy charge, creating a powerful shock wave that was able to knock down a full-grown person.

==Description==
[[File:ConcussionRifle-TCGGA.png|left|thumb|A [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] firing a concussion rifle]]
The concussion rifle created an explosive blast 4 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in diameter,<ref name="Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia" /> damaging the primary target and any who were standing next to him. The shock wave was strong enough to knock people off their feet. Since the technology required for these weapons was more complex than common [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons, only [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] and [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] produced them. As a [[Sonic weapon/Legends|sonic weapon]], a lightsaber-wielder would not be able to deflect this weapon with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="The Unknown Regions" />

One notable model was the [[Stouker concussion rifle]], a weapon used extensively by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Sissk]] gang. Other models included the [[LJ-50 concussion rifle/Legends|LJ-50 concussion rifle]] and the [[W-90 concussion rifle]], previously known as LJ-90 concussion rifle.

==History==
These rare concussion rifles were used by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]] at several points during his career. [[Kyle Katarn]] used this weapon occasionally. [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] was also known to use a Trandoshan concussion rifle.
